name: Takayama
tagline: An Edo-era mountain town of sake breweries and Hida beef
summary: Takayama in the Japanese Alps has a beautifully preserved old merchant quarter of dark wooden houses, sake breweries and morning markets. Its spring and autumn festivals feature ornate floats, and it's the gateway to the thatched farmhouses of Shirakawa-go.
seasonNote: The Takayama Festival is on 14 to 15 April and 9 to 10 October. Winter is snowy and beautiful. Summer is warm and green.
arrival: The scenic Hida limited express from Nagoya takes about 2.5 hours. Buses link Kanazawa via Shirakawa-go.
gettingAround: Walk the compact centre; buses to Shirakawa-go and the Alps.
cashTip: Cards and IC cards work widely, but carry yen for small shrines, rural buses and food stalls.
foodTip: Hida beef sushi and skewers, Takayama ramen, mitarashi dango and local sake.
buyTip: Sarubobo dolls, Hida furniture and sake.
baseArea: Near the old town or a ryokan
